services.name: Past Exhibits
services.desc: Introducing Chasing the Light an exhibit by The Newburyport Ten & Band of Brushes. The Newburyport Ten and Band of Brushes paint en plein air (a French expression meaning painting outdoors). This exhibit features artwork by Dorothy Aham, Michele Champion, Grace Daly, Karen S Fitzgerald, Mary Francis, Dale Partis Greene, Margery Jennings, Christine Molitor Johnson, Fran Kaplan, Marjet Lesk, Kris Monroe, Mary Parks, Susan Spellman, Mary Ann Varoski, and Mary Carolyn Webber.
